title: DMV California Practice Flashcards - Set 1
description: 15 essential DMV questions and answers for California driving test preparation

cards.question: It is illegal for a person 21 years of age or older to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) that is ____ or higher.
cards.answer: 0.08% - eight hundredths of one percent

cards.question: You must notify DMV within 5 days if you:
cards.answer: sell or transfer your vehicle

cards.question: You are getting ready to make a right turn. You should:
cards.answer: signal during the last 100 feet before you turn

cards.question: For which of the following traffic lights must you always stop your vehicle?
cards.answer: solid red lights, flashing red lights, and blacked-out traffic signals

cards.question: When is it legal to use a cell phone without a hands-free device while driving?
cards.answer: when making a call for emergency assistance

cards.question: When a traffic signal light isn't working at an intersection, you should:
cards.answer: come to a complete stop then proceed when it is safe

cards.question: You should adjust your rear view and side view mirrors:
cards.answer: before you start driving

cards.question: Smoking inside a vehicle when a person younger than 18 years of age is present is:
cards.answer: illegal at all times

cards.question: You must make a written report of traffic accident occurring in California (SR 1) to DMV if you:
cards.answer: are involved in a collision and there is more than $750 in damages

cards.question: It is a good habit to signal continuously during the last 100 feet before you turn at an intersection:
cards.answer: even if you do not see any other vehicles around

cards.question: When sharing the road with a light rail vehicle:
cards.answer: never turn in front of an approaching light rail vehicle

cards.question: You are driving at night on a dimly lit street and using high beams. You should dim your lights when you are within 500 feet of:
cards.answer: a vehicle approaching you from behind

cards.question: Allow extra space in front of your vehicle when following a:
cards.answer: large tour bus

cards.question: Even if you know your vehicle can maneuver a sharp curve at the legal speed limit, you should still slow down because:
cards.answer: there may be a stalled car or collision ahead that you can't see

cards.question: You park your car at the curb on a level two-way street. Before getting out of your car, you should:
cards.answer: look for cars or bicycles on the traffic side of your vehicle

title: DMV California Practice Flashcards - Set 2
description: 15 essential DMV questions covering right-of-way, safety, and road rules for California driving test

cards.question: Who has the right-of-way at an intersection with no crosswalks?
cards.answer: pedestrians always have the right-of-way

cards.question: If you approach a curve or the top of a hill and you do not have a clear view of the road ahead, you should:
cards.answer: slow down so you can stop if necessary

cards.question: Whose responsibility is it to know how your medications affect your driving?
cards.answer: yours

cards.question: Which of the following is true about safety belts and collisions?
cards.answer: they increase your chances of survival in most types of collisions

cards.question: If you are unable to see the road ahead while driving because of heavy fog and your wipers do not help, you should:
cards.answer: pull off the road completely until visibility improves

cards.question: This red and white sign means:
cards.answer: you may not enter the road from your direction

cards.question: You are required to wear your safety belt in a moving vehicle:
cards.answer: and failure to do so will result in a traffic ticket

cards.question: You are crossing an intersection and an emergency vehicle is approaching with a siren and flashing lights. You should:
cards.answer: pull to the right in the intersection and stop

cards.question: You are on a two-way road and the vehicle ahead of you is turning left into a driveway. You may legally pass on the right:
cards.answer: if there is enough road between the curb and the vehicle

cards.question: If you have a green light, but traffic is blocking the intersection:
cards.answer: stay out of the intersection and wait until traffic clears

cards.question: This white sign means:
cards.answer: look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing, if necessary

cards.question: Which statement is true about motorcyclists and motorists?
cards.answer: motorcyclists have the same rights/responsibilities as other motorists

cards.question: When you change or merge with another lane, you:
cards.answer: need at least a 4-second gap in traffic

cards.question: Your wheels should be pointed straight ahead, unless you are:
cards.answer: parked on a hill or sloping driveway

cards.question: You are driving in the far right lane of a four-lane freeway and notice thick broken white lines on the left side of your lane. You are driving in:
cards.answer: an exit lane

title: DMV California Practice Flashcards - Set 3
description: 15 essential DMV questions covering lane changes, U-turns, cargo rules, and school zones for California driving test

cards.question: If five or more vehicles are following you on a narrow two-lane road:
cards.answer: drive into the turnout areas or lanes to let them pass

cards.question: Which of these is a legal U-turn?
cards.answer: on a divided highway where there is a paved opening for a turn

cards.question: You see a car approaching from the rear. When you check your mirror again to change lanes, you no longer see the car:
cards.answer: look over your shoulder to be sure the car isn't in your blind spot

cards.question: If you are towing another vehicle or trailer on a freeway with four lanes in your direction, you may travel in:
cards.answer: either of the two right lanes

cards.question: This red and white sign means you should:
cards.answer: give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross

cards.question: To be sure a lane is clear before you change lanes, you should:
cards.answer: glance over your shoulder into the lane you want to enter

cards.question: When driving in fog, snow, or rain you should use your:
cards.answer: low beam headlights

cards.question: Which of these statements is true about child passengers?
cards.answer: children under the age one should not ride in the front seat in airbag-equipped vehicles

cards.question: All of the following are dangerous while driving. Which is also illegal?
cards.answer: wearing a headset that covers both ears

cards.question: You should stop before crossing railroad tracks:
cards.answer: any time a train may be approaching, whether or not you can see it

cards.question: To turn left from a one-way street, start from:
cards.answer: the lane closest to the left curb

cards.question: Cargo extending more than four feet from your rear bumper:
cards.answer: must be marked with a red flag or lights

cards.question: A pedestrian who is blind or is visually impaired uses traffic sounds before deciding to cross the street. If you see a pedestrian with a guide dog or white cane waiting to cross at a corner, you should:
cards.answer: pull up to the crosswalk so the person can hear your engine

cards.question: Two vehicles are approaching an uncontrolled "T" intersection. One vehicle is on the through road and the other is on the road that ends. Who has the right-of-way at the intersection?
cards.answer: the vehicle on the through road

cards.question: The speed limit for a school zone where children are present is ____.
cards.answer: 25 mph

title: DMV California Practice Flashcards - Set 4
description: 12 essential DMV questions covering peace officers, medications, crossing guards, and parking rules for California driving test

cards.question: A peace officer is signaling you to drive to the edge of the roadway. You decide to ignore the officer's warning and flee the scene. You are guilty of a misdemeanor and can be punished by being:
cards.answer: jailed in the county jail for not more than one year

cards.question: Which of these statements is true about driving and taking medications?
cards.answer: most cold medications can make a person drowsy

cards.question: Instructions from school crossing guard must be obeyed:
cards.answer: at all times

cards.question: Which of the following is true about large trucks?
cards.answer: trucks often appear to travel slower because of their large size

cards.question: If there is a deep puddle in the road ahead, you should:
cards.answer: avoid the puddle, if possible

cards.question: The speed limit in any alley is:
cards.answer: 15 mph

cards.question: This yellow sign means:
cards.answer: vehicles on this road travel in two directions

cards.question: You are approaching a sharp curve in the road. You should:
cards.answer: start braking before you enter the curve

cards.question: When parking on any hill, always set your parking brake and:
cards.answer: leave your vehicle in gear or the "park" position

cards.question: All children under age six riding in your vehicle must use a child passenger restraint system unless:
cards.answer: they weigh 60 pounds or more and wear a safety belt

cards.question: This yellow sign means:
cards.answer: there is a pedestrian crossing ahead

cards.question: This lane in the middle of a two-way street is used to:
cards.answer: begin or end left turns, or start a permitted U-turn

title: DMV California Practice Flashcards - Set 5
description: 15 essential DMV questions covering intersections, pedestrians, emergency situations, and safe driving practices for California driving test

cards.question: When you see this yellow sign, you should:
cards.answer: be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk

cards.question: You must notify DMV within 5 days if you:
cards.answer: sell or transfer your vehicle

cards.question: It is illegal for a person 21 years of age or older to drive with a blood alcohol consumption (BAC) that is ___ or higher.
cards.answer: 0.08% - eight hundredths of one percent

cards.question: You are driving 55 mph on a two-lane highway, one lane in each direction, and want to pass the car ahead of you. To pass safely, you need to:
cards.answer: have a large enough gap in the oncoming traffic

cards.question: If you approach an intersection without a stop sign or signals, you:
cards.answer: slow down and be ready to stop if necessary

cards.question: If a driver looks like he or she is going to pull out in front of you, the safest thing to do is:
cards.answer: slow or stop your car and use your horn

cards.question: When approaching a crosswalk where a blind pedestrian is waiting to cross, you must stop:
cards.answer: at the crosswalk and wait for the pedestrian to cross the street

cards.question: You are crossing an intersection and an emergency vehicle is approaching with a siren and flashing lights. You should:
cards.answer: continue through the intersection, pull to the right, and stop

cards.question: You must notify law enforcement and make a written report of traffic accident occurring in California (SR 1) to DMV if:
cards.answer: you are involved in a collision and there is a death

cards.question: To see vehicles in your blind spots, you must look:
cards.answer: over your shoulders

cards.question: Smoking inside a vehicle when a person younger than 18 years of age is present is:
cards.answer: illegal at all times

cards.question: You are stopped at an intersection. The traffic light just turned green. Should you go immediately?
cards.answer: yes, but yield to any vehicle or person still in the intersection

cards.question: If your cell phone rings while you are driving and you do not have a hands-free device, you should:
cards.answer: let the call go to voicemail

cards.question: When driving near road work zones, you should:
cards.answer: pass the work zone carefully and avoid "rubbernecking"

cards.question: It is very foggy. You should slow down, turn on your windshield wipers, and your:
cards.answer: low beam lights
